code_defects.description: No listing-boundary (first_trading_day) awareness; unconditionally emits the first trading day's preceding-night window.
code_defects.fix_requirement: Accept a governed listing/effective-start boundary and suppress the night window for any trading day whose preceding-night session falls before the contract's effective start.

code_defects.description: Builds SessionMetadata over the full spec effective period (2024-01-01..2025-12-31), not the contract's governed first_trading_day..last_trading_day; pre-listing windows enter the metadata identity.
code_defects.fix_requirement: Pass the governed universe bounds into build_session_metadata so session windows respect the contract's listing window.

code_defects.description: No first-trading-day handling; requests prev 21:00 -> day 15:00 for the first trading day unconditionally.
code_defects.fix_requirement: For the contract's first trading day, either request day-session-only (09:00-15:00) or bind first-night existence to verified authority before requesting it.

code_defects.description: Old acquisition builder masked truncation as PASS for all 116 first-day partitions; repaired _acquire_partition now flags returned_coverage_truncated but the accepted corpus still holds the masked records.
code_defects.fix_requirement: Governance action: re-classify the 116 accepted partitions or re-acquire under corrected scope; never re-introduce PASS masking.

critical_findings: All 116 failures are the contract's first manifest partition on the governed first trading day; zero regular-day partitions are truncated (0/31980 at 21:00 requests).

The provider's stored historical data for these first trading days is incomplete (ragged, product-clustered, including day-session gaps e.g. al2501 missing 09:00-10:44, ni2511 = 1 bar); no planner or authority change can recover day-session data the provider does not store.
high_findings: 28 newly-listed contracts have clean first trading days, so first-day truncation is not universal and not a fixed listing rule.
Truncation and clean first days are fully interleaved in acquisition time (retrospective 2026-08-16/17), ruling out network/batch artifacts; re-download is inferred to reproduce the truncation.
29 MULTIPLE_REGIONS failures (ni:15, al:8, cu:5, rb:1) have the entire first night session and part of the first day session absent; au/ag have no such cases.
Old manifest recorded all 116 failures as PASS (truncation masked), and the session authority/planner lack listing-boundary awareness (over-generated first-day night expected coverage).
